# OnSite_Advanced_Manufacturing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The capability to produce complex components or systems directly at the point of use, enabled by advanced materials and automated processes. Demands embedded, real-time computational control and sensing, which are core strengths of iNEST neuromorphic and TCC topologically optimized designs.
